scientific.integrity: The field claims are deduced from an exhaustive exact Galois action on all 16 projective planes, with no floating-point or heuristic step.
scientific.limitations: The statement is for the fixed embedded Bonnafé--Sarti model and their specific 16-conic \(A\)-orbit; it does not classify all Nikulin configurations or arbitrary isomorphic models.

title: Exact descent field of the explicit Nikulin configuration on \(X_{\mathrm{BH}}\)
